title: (RHBA-2018:1728) Update to Fuse 7.0 images
portal_summary: This update addresses the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) issue https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2018-3639
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.9|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse on OpenShift images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Ignite images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)

These images are intended for use with the following components (unchanged since the previous patch):
* Red Hat Fuse version: 7.0.0.fuse-000191-redhat-1
* BOM version: 3.0.11.fuse-000039-redhat-1
* Fabric8 Maven plug-in version: 3.5.33.fuse-000067-redhat-1
* Archetype version: 2.2.0.fuse-000092-redhat-2

Update your Fuse on OpenShift / Fuse Online deployments to use the updated images.
portal_description: This update for the Red Hat Fuse 7.0.0 release of 'Fuse on OpenShift' and 'Fuse Ignite' images incorporates the Critical Security Advisory https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2018:1649 that addresses CVE-2018-3639 on OpenJDK 1.8.0.
